We have used DFW twice over the last 10 years and have been very pleased with the service and their product.  They are quick and responsive. We acquired bids from other companies and DFW Fence was not only competitive (cheaper in some cases) but their product and workmanship far exceeds their competitors.

The entire process was excellent. Marcus (the owner) is fantastic to work with. Communication is excellent. The guys that built the fence came and got us when they had a question on how we would prefer certain things done, instead of just doing it. They were also very professional and did a beautiful job on the fence. It completely transformed our back yard. Hopefully I will never need another fence, but if do,  they will be who I call. Highly recommend.
